description: Read a LinkedIn company page you administer, as one of your connected accounts (query account_id): its name, tagline, overview (the About text), website, page address, industries, company size, company type, phone, year founded, specialties, custom button, logo and cover, and the sizes, types and buttons this page accepts. company_id is the page's number or its urn. -- MakeHybrid API plan, GET /linkedin/pages/{company_id}, group pages.

company_id.description: Value for the {company_id} segment of /linkedin/pages/{company_id}. Required; pass it raw (it is URL-escaped for you).

query.description: Optional query-string parameters, e.g. {"limit":"20","cursor":"..."}. Values are coerced to strings.
